==Behind the scenes==
The striped gizka was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "Completing the Collection" of the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="Mission" />
